summary: Frontend-only verification of tab navigation on static site (index.html and inscricao.html). All 3 tests PASSED: (1) /inscricao -> click 'Dados do Concurso' navigates to '/' and shows Sobral/Edital content; (2) '/' -> click 'Inscrições' navigates to /inscricao showing form content (CPF/Seleção de Cargo/Inscrição de Concurso); (3) /farpapainel/ returns HTTP 200 (regression intact).
critical_code_review_comments: CSP violation in console for cloudflareinsights.com beacon and cdn-cgi challenge-platform scripts (script-src 'unsafe-inline' data:). Not blocking tab navigation but may affect analytics/edge features. Consider allowing static.cloudflareinsights.com if analytics is desired.
The tab <li> uses both onclick='window.location.href=...' and inner <a href='...'> — redundant but not harmful. The inner <a> alone would suffice with pointer cursor styling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site tabs (data-testid='tab-dados-do-concurso' in /inscricao and data-testid='tab-inscricoes' in /) navigate correctly via <a href>. craco middleware serves /inscricao->inscricao.html and /->index.html. Admin panel /farpapainel/ intact (HTTP 200).
